title: Dynamic Station Bursar network: 1 trader per policed Exchange station (live book refresh, bottleneck buy_order, surplus sell_order)
note: Policy-driven dynamic Bursar network governed by game/bursar-policy.json (Mercury/Unity). Each trader atomically claims 1 unstaffed Exchange station (preferring current dock and own empire), refreshes market & mission books at 0 fuel, posts wholesale buy_order walls for open needs.tsv bottlenecks, and liquidates unreserved surplus without self-undercutting. 2026-11-24 10:56 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 56 -> 28. 2026-11-24 11:07 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 28 -> 55. 2026-11-24 (Trinity, Suggi approved): max_ships 55 -> 65 (60+ safe empire + non-pirate neutral hubs permanently staffed) with requires.max_hull_tier=0 & max_cargo=150 so T1/T2 (Prayer/Apophenia) and Cargo Expander II traders (~24+ ships) automatically stay reserved for mobile multi-hub trading, crafting, and loot delivery.
